sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A repeating 3-part loop — arm smash → collection → burn — with a hard downstate check at 50%. 8-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Arm smashes & adds
bullets: Squad stacks on the middle two of the platform's four tiles. <mark>Pulverize</mark> is the arm smash — it knocks down anyone in the targeted section, while <mark>Tremor</mark> damages anyone standing outside it, so don't try to dodge Pulverize by leaving the section entirely.
The first smash spawns sword adds — killing them grants a Conjured Slash special action key (50% damage debuff on the boss); save these for the second slam instead of using them right away.

The second smash spawns shield adds with their own breakbar — break it, kill them, and you get Conjured Protection (blocks some of the boss's attacks). Save these for Thunderclap. Sword action keys can also break shield breakbars while cleaving through.
If swords/shields aren't killed fast enough they merge into much nastier Warriors — don't let that happen.

sections.heading: Collection phase
bullets: One player collects sword bubbles: grab 4, use the action key on the 5th, repeat — save the last 5 for the next hand phase.
One player collects and holds shield bubbles rather than using them immediately.
Everyone else stacks center and keeps damaging the boss.

sections.heading: Burn phase — Junk Torrent
bullets: After collection, <mark>Junk Torrent</mark> sweeps a fatal wall across the platform starting from the side of the arm you just killed, leaving damaging <mark>Ruptured Ground</mark> behind it. The shield collector pops shields right before it hits.
High-DPS squads can kill the boss before the wall returns; lower-DPS squads can reposition to the far side and use one shield activation to cover both the outgoing and returning wall.

sections.heading: Thunderclap (50%)
bullets: At 50% health, the boss goes invulnerable and casts <mark>Thunderclap</mark>, downing the entire squad unless you're covered by a saved Conjured Protection, a defensive like Rebound, or similar precast protection.

sections.heading: Second phase
bullets: At 25%, both arms respawn at 50% health. Focus one arm down through another collection cycle while keeping damage on the other hand — if you're too slow, the first arm respawns and the time pressure compounds.
Each arm defeat takes 10% of the boss's total health; the last 5% is a straight burn.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 8:00 — Conjured Amalgamate and all adds deal +200% damage past this point.
